description: On the bed in front of you, there’s a small rectangular box with a blue top and a wooden block with a red “A,” with a pillow propped up behind them. The left hand stays mostly resting on the bed while the right hand reaches forward, grasps the “A” block as a right-hand object, lifts it, moves it toward the box, and sets it down on top of the box to stack it, then begins to release.
